The evidence supports the claim that CD-TVD uses grid-based input representation (implied by the contrast with 'distinct input representation compared to grid-based upscaling' for the alternative method) and that there is an alternative method (Gu et al.) that uses streamlines. However, the evidence does not state that CD-TVD is 'chosen when data is available in streamline format'. In fact, the text describes CD-TVD as a diffusion-based approach for scientific volume SR (typically grid-based) and contrasts it with an 'alternative formulation' that recovers grid-based fields from streamlines. The claim incorrectly attributes the streamline-based selection logic to CD-TVD, whereas the text suggests CD-TVD is the standard grid-based diffusion approach, and the streamline method is a separate alternative.
